verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is one community user saying a new model 'on HF or Ollama registry' is available with a single 'ollama pull', which suggests Ollama can fetch Hugging Face models directly. No first-party documentation in the pack describes Hugging Face integration; other pull and run references concern Ollama's own library. Missing for 10: first-party docs on pulling from Hugging Face (syntax, supported formats such as GGUF, quantization selection), confirmation of running HF models without manual conversion, and corroboration beyond a single anecdote.
